theoretical_statement: Damping-to-τ recycling is constructive only when τ is bounded tightly enough to prevent localized over-recharge; under regulated τ, dissipated energy becomes a distributed creation resource rather than a hot-spot instability.

optimal.note: Sustained topology with regulated damping recycling

comparison.statistical_significance: Clear separation with no overlap between conditions

validated_loop: Topology → damping energy → regulated τ recharge → distributed creation → sustained topology
key_finding: The τ cap is not numerical protection — it is part of the physics of the recovery loop
